dct_description_sm: Initial limnological work at the Arctic LTER began at Toolik Lake in 1975. Through the years the research has expanded to include over two dozen additional lakes and ponds in an effort to better understand the controls on arctic lake ecosystem structure and function. Each summer the Arctic LTER monitors physical and chemical parameters in Toolik as well as several other lakes in the area.  In conjunction with long term monitoring several whole lake ecosystem experiments have been carried out in order to understand nutrient cycling and trophic interactions.

dct_title_s: Arctic Long Term Ecological Research (LTER): Lakes in Alaska
